trace=[
  {"step":1,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":16,"var":"data/size","code":"buf.data = (UA_Byte*)data; buf.length = size;","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped as a JSON byte string and passed into the decoder.","depends_on":[]},
  {"step":2,"file":"tests/fuzz/fuzz_json_decode.cc","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":25,"var":"out","code":"UA_decodeJson(&buf, &out, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_VARIANT]);","note":"The fuzzer decodes the input as a Variant, so nested JSON can instantiate heap-backed built-in types.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"buf"}]},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJson","line":2918,"var":"dst->type","code":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject(UA_Variant *dst, const UA_DataType *type, ...)","note":"Variant decoding can unwrap ExtensionObjects and recursively decode the embedded body as another concrete type.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"variant body"}]},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"Variant_decodeJsonUnwrapExtensionObject","line":2990,"var":"dst->data","code":"dst->data = UA_new(dst->type);","note":"The unwrapped body is heap-allocated as the concrete decoded type, creating ownership that later cleanup must release exactly once.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"type dispatch"}]},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/ua_types_encoding_json.c","function":"DiagnosticInfo_decodeJson","line":2753,"var":"dst->localizedText / dst->locale / dst->additionalInfo","code":"{UA_JSONKEY_LOCALIZEDTEXT, &dst->localizedText, (decodeJsonSignature) Int32_decodeJson, false, NULL}, {UA_JSONKEY_LOCALE, &dst->locale, (decodeJsonSignature) Int32_decodeJson, false, NULL}, {UA_JSONKEY_ADDITIONALINFO, &dst->additionalInfo, (decodeJsonSignature) String_decodeJson, false, NULL}","note":"A crafted body can also drive nested DiagnosticInfo decoding, which allocates an inner string member that is later freed through the generic clear path.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"concrete body type"}]},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"DiagnosticInfo_clear","line":null,"var":"p->additionalInfo / p->innerDiagnosticInfo","code":"String_clear(&p->additionalInfo, NULL); if(p->hasInnerDiagnosticInfo && p->innerDiagnosticInfo) { ... }","note":"Cleanup of DiagnosticInfo frees the additionalInfo string and then recursively clears the inner diagnostic info, so any alias to the same heap buffer becomes dangling.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"control","via":"deleteMembers"}]},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":null,"var":"p->data","code":"String_clear(&p->additionalInfo, NULL);","note":"The string buffer is released here, which is the first half of the use-after-free chain.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"freed string buffer"}]},
  {"step":8,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"UA_clear","line":977,"var":"dst","code":"UA_clear(dst, type);","note":"The generic clear dispatcher walks the decoded object graph and invokes the nested frees on the attacker-controlled structure.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"control","via":"dispatcher"}]},
  {"step":9,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"DiagnosticInfo_clear","line":null,"var":"p->innerDiagnosticInfo","code":"if(p->hasInnerDiagnosticInfo && p->innerDiagnosticInfo) { ... UA_clear(p->innerDiagnosticInfo, &UA_TYPES[UA_TYPES_DIAGNOSTICINFO]); }","note":"Recursive cleanup can revisit nested diagnostic info after the outer string has already been freed, exposing stale references if the decoder created aliasing.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"data","via":"recursive clear"}]},
  {"step":10,"file":"src/ua_types.c","function":"String_clear","line":null,"var":"p->additionalInfo","code":"String_clear(&p->additionalInfo, NULL);","note":"The sink is a second access to the same freed string storage during recursive cleanup, matching the reported heap-use-after-free read.","depends_on":[{"on":9,"type":"data","via":"dangling alias"}]}]
open('/workspace/candidate_trace.json','w').write(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/poc2.json /workspace/candidate_trace.json
